prompt:
Use case: photorealistic visual learning asset for the Hanzi 桌; subject ID table only.
Primary request: one vertical 1024x1792 photographic triptych containing exactly three independent horizontal landscape photographs stacked top to bottom, separated by two narrow straight white horizontal seams approximately 8 pixels thick near y=597 and y=1195. No outer border.
Top photograph: one empty full-height wooden dining table in a quiet naturally lit dining area. A rectangular tabletop and four ordinary supporting legs are clearly visible in a three-quarter view. The tabletop is completely bare, without food, dishes, flowers, cloth or other objects; no chairs obscure the table.
Middle photograph: one empty wooden writing desk in a quiet naturally lit study. A rectangular worktop, ordinary full-height supporting legs and a small integrated drawer beneath the tabletop make it recognizable as a desk. The desktop is completely bare, with no books, stationery, screen, lamp or other objects, and no chair obscuring the desk.
Bottom photograph: one empty low wooden table in a quiet naturally lit sitting area, clearly much lower than the dining table or desk. Show its complete rectangular tabletop and short supporting legs in a three-quarter view. Its tabletop is completely bare; no ornaments, books, cups, cloth or other objects, and no seating obscures it.
Composition/framing: exactly three standalone wide landscape interior photographs in empty dining table, empty writing desk, empty low table order. Center each entire table including every visible leg and foot, with at least 12 percent clear crop-safe margin around all tabletop corners and leg ends. Show a little floor around every leg. Similar natural camera perspective, uncluttered pale walls and neutral floors. Each cropped panel independently communicates a different kind of table.
Style/medium: authentic photorealistic interior photography, natural wood grain, subtle material wear and joinery, credible furniture proportions and construction, soft natural window daylight with believable shadows and true-to-life colors. Not a cartoon, illustration, miniature or CGI render.
Constraints: exactly three panels and two thin white seams; only the requested furniture contexts, no people. All tabletops must be empty. No writing, labels, letters, numbers, logos, brands, captions, watermark or decorative graphics.
reviewNotes: Inspected only the 300x525 JPEG preview. Top shows an empty wooden dining table; middle shows an empty wooden writing desk with an integrated drawer; bottom shows an empty short-legged wooden low table on a rug. All tabletops are bare and their complete visible furniture silhouettes fit inside their panels. Natural wood grain, soft window light and ordinary room backgrounds are visible. Backgrounds include a cabinet, plants, bookshelves, window seating and a partial woven stool, none obscuring the requested tables. Dining-table leg ends have less than the requested 12 percent bottom margin but remain clear of the 8-pixel inset. No visible people, readable writing, logos or watermark at compact resolution; tiny background book details are not verified. Sharp measured white seam rows 605–612 and 1204–1211 in the 1024x1792 original; rounded centers 609 and 1208. Panel heights differ slightly.
